# `new_jsf_result()`

Create a JSFResult object

## Usage

```r
new_jsf_result(
  time,
  state,
  species_names = names(state),
  method = "operator-splitting",
  config = list()
)
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `time` | Numeric vector of simulation times. |
| `state` | Data frame of state trajectories. |
| `species_names` | Character vector of species names. Defaults to the column names of `state`. |
| `method` | JSF simulation method used. |
| `config` | List of simulation configuration values. |

## Value

A `JSFResult` object.

## Examples

```r
state <- data.frame(
  prey = c(50, 51, 52),
  predator = c(10, 9, 9)
)

result <- new_jsf_result(
  time = c(0, 0.1, 0.2),
  state = state,
  config = list(dt = 0.1)
)

result
summary(result)
```
